sections.html: This is only the third species in the nine Clupisoma genera recorded that is found in China. The other two are Clupisoma nujiangense and Clupisoma sinense. Family: Ailiidae. Common name: none. IUCN Red List: Not Evaluated.
Asia: Mekong River, Lancangjiang River. Type locality: Puer county, Xiaoganlanba, Yunnan, China.
Oviparous, eggs are unguarded with distinct pairing of the adults.

Etymology: The genus name Clupisoma: clupea, herring; soma, body, referring to the herring-shaped body. The specific name longianale: longus, long; analis, anal, referring to longer anal fin compared to C. sinense.

Remarks: Clupisoma longianale is still listed in Fishbase as being Clupisoma longianalis but it is updated in The Catalog of Fishes as the current name of Clupisoma longianale.

Chen, X.-Y., C.J. Ferraris Jr. and J.-X. Yang, 2005. A new species of catfish of the genus Clupisoma (Siluriformes: Schilbidae) from the Salween River, Yunnan, China. Copeia 2005(3):566-570.
